$comment: Repo-wide chain policy, written by humans and refused to agent sessions by bin/guard.sh. A ticket may override the relaxable keys in work/<T>/policy.json. Acceptance of the intent and the spec has no key: it is always a person's, and only a ticket that predates the gate is exempt. bin/policy.sh resolves the effective value and fails closed to 'required'.

values.by-risk: required when the ticket's risk label is high, and for architectureReview also when the spec's Contract names an event or more than one module; optional otherwise
